Vibrant paint-splattered trucks, bursts of color, and electrifying lighting turn every smash, and crash, into a vivid spectacle the whole family can see, feel, and remember. Every wheelie, jump, donut and freestyle run brings the color roaring back, building to a full-arena burst of light, sound, and pure Monster Truck energy. It's the show you love, reimagined like you've never seen it
